MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
MATCH (p)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
MATCH (t)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND (
    CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) < 0
    OR (
      CASE
        WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
        ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64)
      END < 1984
      OR (
        CASE
          WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
          ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64)
        END = 1984
        AND (
          CASE
            WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'January') THEN 1
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'February') THEN 2
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'March') THEN 3
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'April') THEN 4
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'May') THEN 5
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'June') THEN 6
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'July') THEN 7
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'August') THEN 8
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'September') THEN 9
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'October') THEN 10
            WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'November') THEN 11
            ELSE 12
          END < 10
          OR (
            CASE
              WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'January') THEN 1
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'February') THEN 2
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'March') THEN 3
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'April') THEN 4
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'May') THEN 5
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'June') THEN 6
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'July') THEN 7
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'August') THEN 8
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'September') THEN 9
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'October') THEN 10
              WHEN starts_with(p.birth_date, 'November') THEN 11
              ELSE 12
            END = 10
            AND CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '[0-9]{1,2}', 0) AS INT64) <= 14
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
